description:
Sites that serve .ico favicons (Variety, Deadline, etc.) render as a gray
placeholder block in the UI.

## Root cause (found by tracing favicon_storage.cr)

src/favicon_storage.cr:169-194 (handle_save_favicon):

  ext = extension_from_content_type(content_type)   # "ico" for image/x-icon
  is_tiny = image_data.size < FAVICON_ABSOLUTE_MIN ||
            (ext == "ico" && image_data.size < FAVICON_MIN_SIZE)   # <800 bytes

  write_atomically(filepath, image_data)

  if is_tiny
    if google_saved = do_fetch_google_favicon(url)
      File.delete(filepath) if File.exists?(filepath)   # <<< deletes the real .ico
      return google_saved
    end
  end

1. The 800-byte threshold for .ico is wrong. A real 16x16 .ico is typically
   ~700-1500 bytes (header + image data + AND mask). Many production sites
   (Variety, Deadline) ship favicons in this size range. They are valid,
   not "tiny placeholders" — the heuristic mis-classifies them.

2. Google's s2/favicons endpoint returns PNG. If it succeeds, the original
   .ico is deleted and the PNG path is returned. If it fails (network,
   rate-limit, transient), the code falls through and returns the .ico
   path — that path is correct. So (2) alone isn't the bug.

3. The likely actual failure mode: VugAdapter parses Variety/Deadline HTML,
   sees no <link rel="icon">, falls back to "/favicon.ico". The request
   comes in with content-type "image/x-icon" → ext=ico, size ~1000 bytes.
   is_tiny=true (because ICO<800). Google fallback is attempted. If Google
   returns 0 bytes or invalid image data, valid_image_data? returns false,
   do_fetch_google_favicon returns nil, and the code returns the .ico path
   correctly. BUT: if Google's response is <800 bytes of valid PNG (e.g.,
   Google's PNG stub when no real icon exists), the PNG is saved, the .ico
   is deleted, and we serve a Google PNG placeholder — which is exactly
   the "gray block" symptom: a valid image with no useful content.

## Reproduction
- Add Variety (variety.com) and Deadline (deadline.com) to feeds.yml
- Wait for refresh — gray block where favicon should be
- Check public/favicons/ — files are present (PNG from Google) but small
- In browser dev tools: image loads successfully (200 OK, correct mime),
  but content is a 16x16 PNG that's effectively blank

## Fix plan
1. Tighten is_tiny logic. An .ico < 800 bytes is normal, not a sign of a
   bad favicon. Only fall back if the ICO is absurdly small (<200 bytes,
   the FAVICON_ABSOLUTE_MIN threshold) OR not a valid icon. Consider
   parsing the ICO header to count frames and pick the largest, rather
   than comparing total size.

2. If Google fallback succeeds but produces a tiny PNG, keep the original
   .ico. Don't delete the real favicon unless the replacement is genuinely
   better.

3. Validate by size AND content: Google placeholder PNGs are ~100 bytes.
   Reject fallbacks below a reasonable size.

## Acceptance
- Variety, Deadline favicons render correctly in timeline and feed views
- No regression: existing working favicons continue to work
- The cache should self-heal: existing cached Google PNGs need to be
  invalidated/refreshed, or the migration runs on next startup

## Files involved
- src/favicon_storage.cr (handle_save_favicon, do_fetch_google_favicon,
  FAVICON_MIN_SIZE, FAVICON_ABSOLUTE_MIN)
- src/favicon_storage.cr (valid_image_data? — currently returns true for
  any 200+ byte image, no minimum quality check)
- spec/favicon_storage_spec.cr (likely missing — add tests for ICO
  handling)
title: [BUG] ICO favicons render as gray block (Variety, Deadline, etc.)
